what_works: Acid-yellow-green and dark charcoal pairing turns a sustainability brand into something that feels both heritage and fresh — the hero header is a single oversized headline, no image, with material samples revealed on scroll. Translates to a multi-generation landscaping family that wants to feel modern without abandoning warmth.
what_does_not_translate: Scroll-video zoom and 3D material renders need a real motion budget — keep the yellow-green/charcoal palette and the type-led hero, drop the 3D.
type_observations: One heavy editorial serif at hero scale, one disciplined grotesk for body; the color pair carries more identity than the type.
